transcript.text: I need to flag a cost constraint before we proceed. While reconciling a cloud invoice from a separate model experiment, I confirmed that this feature's production inference endpoint costs $0.18 per request rather than the planned $0.06. At a 10% cohort that projects to $14,400 per month. Because of this, my operational constraint is that the initial cohort must be exactly 5% and a cost alert must trigger at exactly $8,000 monthly spend. I confirmed these numbers minutes ago but have not yet updated the rollout proposal.

transcript.text: I need to state my engineering operational constraint. While debugging an unrelated queue-consumer issue this morning, I measured that more than 2 concurrent inference requests can exhaust the triage worker's connection pool. When that happens, timeouts bypass the intended manual-review fallback and leave tickets without a routing label. I have not filed this finding in the launch ticket yet. My operational constraint is that concurrency must be capped at 2 in the rollout configuration. The good news is that capping concurrency at 2 is sufficient to satisfy this engineering constraint — no separate engineering deployment is required before flag enablement.

transcript.text: I need to state my customer operations operational constraint. During a customer-account review for another queue change, I confirmed that six accounts — AsterBank, Northstar Health, LumaPay, GreenField Benefits, Harbor Mutual, and Vantage Clinics — prohibit automated ticket decisions until they receive 72 hours' notice and retain human review. None has been notified yet, and I have not added this clause to the launch checklist. Because enablement is scheduled for Tuesday at 10:00 UTC, notices must be sent by Saturday 10:00 UTC to satisfy the 72-hour notice period. My operational constraint is that these six accounts must be excluded from the automated cohort, human review must be retained for them, and notices must be committed by Saturday 10:00 UTC. The rollout flag may still be approved for Tuesday enablement provided these protections are configured and committed.
